userFolder.title: UserFolder
userFolder.description: A saved AU character preset or folder containing template state and character metadata.

userEmail.description: Google account email of the folder owner.

userId.description: User identifier (Google UID or sanitized email).

platform.description: Platform identifier (e.g. twitter, instagram, whatsapp, tiktok, ios, line).

subFeature.description: Sub-feature identifier (e.g. feed, story, dm, chat, fyp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this folder was last updated.

userWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
userWorkspace.description: User account workspace bundle storing character presets, drafts, and active form states permanently tied to Google Account email.

userId.description: User unique identifier (Google UID or sanitized email).

characters.description: Map of character presets by platform.

formStates.description: Active form state and drafts across platforms.

folderStates.description: Map of folder-specific isolated state data.

updatedBy.description: Client session ID that triggered the update.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when workspace was last synced.

workspaceTab.title: WorkspaceTab
workspaceTab.description: Granular tab partition for user workspace keeping individual documents well under the 1MB Firestore limit.

characters.description: Array of character presets for this platform tab.

formState.description: Current form state data for this platform tab.

folderStates.description: Saved folder states specific to this platform tab.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this tab document was last updated.

userDevice.title: UserDevice
userDevice.description: Device registration record enforcing max 2 devices (1 mobile + 1 laptop).

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp when device last logged in.

/users/{userId}.description: Root document of persistent user workspace state strictly isolated per Google Sign-In UID or email.

/users/{userId}/tabs/{tabId}.description: Subcollection storing user-isolated tab-specific form states, character presets, and folder states under 1MB limit.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: Private subcollection of saved character folders and template configurations for this active user account.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceType}.description: Subcollection tracking registered mobile and desktop devices for 2-device policy.

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Legacy workspace collection preserved for seamless user migration.

/workspaces/{userId}/tabs/{tabId}.description: Legacy tab subcollection preserved for seamless user migration.
